skill.summary: Use when importing articles, organizing notes, or syncing a knowledge base across Obsidian, Feishu, and Tencent IMA with OpenClaw or Codex.

latestVersion.changelog: Refined OpenClaw metadata so only true hard requirements are marked required. Kept IMA credentials required, moved Feishu placement variables to optional envs, and documented FEISHU_KB_ID / FEISHU_FOLDER_ID routing aliases plus FEISHU_IMPORT_ENDPOINT guidance.
